about: Shot list for the checkout's view C1 (plan 34 part 1 'B'): the story choices only. Each lettered face on a grocery is split from the basket into its own group (so the checker can say whether a word is hidden), and the bill from its stand. The counter, its belt, the neighbouring counters, the divider tray, the stool and the sign's cables are set, not props.
